judge_summary.use: failure-mode motivation only; no judge text or labels become training targets

world_status: previously exposed training worlds; no heldout qualification
context_order: fixed canonical literal-fact order; reverse is evaluation only

training.pair_order: world-major, all 16 pairs each update; sequential gradient accumulation
training.reductions: answer and EOS mean over 32 side rows; donor over 4 affected pairs; stability over 12 unaffected; unrelated over 16; residual over 48 answer/control residuals
training.target_authority: independently verified context-graph oracle; exact lowercase one-token suffix

generation.scorer: entire stripped case-folded no/yes and observed EOS; no first-word rescue

claim_boundary: Engineering finite-update pilot only; no qualified instrument, reader winner, semantic promotion, independent correctness floor or FT-beta release claim. No automatic extension beyond 8 updates.
